067c49a4554f7fafd28c93a733febf208e0c09c1.summary: Morphisec describes a fileless attack first identified on June 7, 2017, targeting restaurants across the US. It says the activity matches the FIN7 group, which it links to the Carbanak gang. The infection starts with a phishing email carrying a Word document that runs obfuscated JavaScript and then loads a Meterpreter session largely from memory. The report says the documents scored 0/56 on VirusTotal and that DNS traffic peaked above 10K requests per hour. It presents fileless attacks as rising and promotes Morphisec's own prevention product.
